messages:
omar: Heads-up: i'm adding an 'SLA regression playbook' appendix to the Dedicated Provisioning docs. Purpose: a compact operator checklist + a small JSON schema for autoscale + a short TypeScript SDK snippet that wires an SLA monitor to a provision. cc @lee @fiona for wording + ops commands.

lee: love this. can we make the playbook strictly step-by-step with exact CLI/SDK commands and one example alert query for our metrics stack? ops really appreciates copy/paste. also call out default thresholds and where customers can override them.

omar: yes. plan: 1) detection (alert query), 2) quick mitigation (throttle/cut canary), 3) capacity action (roll to alternate pool or bump replicas), 4) follow-up (reconcile quotas, file incident). adding sample alert: `sum(rate(requests_total{provision_id=~"%s"}[5m])) by (status)` + p95 latency.

fiona: wording nit: use "mitigate -> remediate -> reconcile" phases. also add isolation note: mention isolation_label and eviction_precedence so readers understand why some pools reject reassign. link to eng-sre eviction runbook.

omar: dropping the short JSON autoscale schema in the doc so customers see exact field names (keeps the examples in-line and small):

```json
{
  "autoscale": {
    "min_replicas": 1,
    "max_replicas": 10,
    "policy": "cpu", 
    "cooldown_seconds": 90,
    "scale_in_grace_seconds": 180,
    "sla": {
      "p95_latency_ms": 250,
      "error_rate_percent": 0.5,
      "evaluation_window_minutes": 10
    }
  }
}
```

lee: nice. add a short paragraph that explains `sla.evaluation_window_minutes` is how long to hold canary before deciding. also clarify that default p95=250ms and error_rate=0.5% are recommended starting points only.

omar: TypeScript snippet to show attaching an SLA monitor during provisioning (short & pasteable):

```ts
import { RedwoodDedicated } from "@redwood/inference"
const client = new RedwoodDedicated({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })

const prov = await client.provisionings.create({
  tenantId: "team-xyz",
  model: "gpt-medium-fp16",
  reservedPool: "us-west-2-reserved-a",
  autoscale: {
    minReplicas: 1,
    maxReplicas: 4,
    policy: "cpu",
    cooldownSeconds: 90,
    sla: { p95LatencyMs: 250, errorRatePercent: 0.5, evaluationWindowMinutes: 10 }
  }
})
console.log("provision id", prov.id)
```

fiona: add the short operator CLI commands for mitigation and capacity ops. suggested bullets: `redwood-cli routing throttle --provision <id> --percent 10`, `redwood-cli pool set-state --pool <pool> --state drain`, `redwood-cli provision scale --id <id> --replicas 6`. also sample SDK call to reassign tenant: `client.provisionings.update(tenantId, { reservedPool: "alt-pool" })`.

omar: good — will include those. CI note: docs-ci-bot, please check link sanity for anything referencing ops/infra/terragrunt or eng-sre.

docs-ci-bot: docs build OK for PR #4688. 1 link suggestion: change `/ops/infra/terragrunt` -> `/ops/infra/terragrunt/README.md` to avoid relative redirect.

omar: thanks, will fix link in the PR. aiming to keep this appendix < 300 words with the JSON + TS snippet and the 6-step playbook. pushing shortly :rocket:
